name: volarb
tagline: Find static arbitrage in option quote grids, and the fewest quotes to drop to remove it
trendOrigin: Trend 4 (diffusion models that generate implied-vol surfaces). Generative surface models are judged on hedging results, but a generated surface that allows static arbitrage is wrong before any hedge runs. I took the gap to be a strict, exact checker that says which quotes are at fault, not a model.
